set system host-name DeviceF.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols isis level 1-2.explanation: Configure the level of the ISIS protocol.

wide-metrics-only.explanation: Configure level 2 of the IS-IS protocol to use width only.

set protocols isis interface all.explanation: Enables an IS-IS protocol on the specified interface.

level 2.explanation: Configure the level of the ISIS interface.

disable.explanation: Disables Level 1 of the IS-IS protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols isis interface all level 1.template: set protocols isis interface [parameter1] level [parameter2] enable
set protocols isis interface all level 1.command: set protocols isis interface all level 1-2 enable
set protocols isis interface all level 1.explanation: 在所有接口上启用ISIS协议的level 1-2。

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: 接口名称，all表示所有接口。

parameters.name: interface

set protocols pim interface ge-1/0/1.explanation: This command enables Protocol Independent Multicast (PIM) on a specified network interface (`[parameter1]`) for multicast routing in Junos OS.

mode sparse.explanation: Configure the mode of PIM protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols isis interface ge-1/0/1 le.explanation: 配置ISIS协议的接口电路类型为level 1-2。

parameters.name: circuit-type
parameters.explanation: ISIS协议的电路类型，level-1-2表示同时支持level 1和level 2。
